releases.notes:
## Voxy Curve 0.1.2

First public release of Voxy Curve, a client-side Fabric addon that bends the farthest [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) LOD terrain downward for a curved, planet-like horizon.

### Features
- Curved horizon for Voxy's distant LOD terrain
- **Curved distance** slider (1% to 100%, default 10%): the share of your Voxy render distance that curves, counted from the far edge inward
- Follows your Voxy render distance automatically
- **Edge drop** setting (0 to 2000 blocks, default 300) controls how strong the curve is
- Curved horizon on/off toggle
- Settings apply instantly, with no restart
- "Voxy Curve" tab in Sodium's Video Settings
- Client-side only, no network access

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) 0.2.20-beta
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) 0.9.2

### Installation
Download `voxy-curve-0.1.2.jar` below and put it in your `mods` folder next to Voxy and Sodium. Don't download the `-sources` file unless you want the source code.

### Known issues
- Iris shader packs are not supported or tested
- Very large far-away LOD blocks bend in straight lines, so the outermost edge can look slightly angular
- Some pop-in may appear at the horizon, because Voxy's culling doesn't account for the curve
- Fog and sky are not adjusted to match the curve
- Polaris cards like the RX500 series have known issues with LOD culling
   can be fix with : https://github.com/Ant0ki/AMD-Patch-for-Voxy-fork/releases/tag/release

### AI disclosure
Most of the code was written by an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic) from my design direction, and I built and tested it in-game. See the README for details.
